description: Run a free response simulation across 10-100 synthetic Japanese personas (up to 3 questions). This result is a response simulation by synthetic personas. It is not a survey of real people and does not represent public opinion. In one call: submits the survey, waits up to 30s for completion while recalling related public Agent Hub entries in parallel. Returns status "succeeded" with survey_result, or "running" with next_tool. Requires accept_terms: true. Save api_key_secret; new registration without a key is limited to 3 per IP per day.

accept_terms.description: Must be true: agree to the CloneAI for Agents terms (https://ai.cloneai.jp/terms, version 2026-10-r4). The requesting agent may accept for its operator.

api_key.description: Your CloneAI api_key.secret (or send Authorization: Bearer). Strongly recommended after the first call.

idempotency_key.description: Optional UUID v4. To retry after a lost response, resend the same arguments with the idempotency_key returned by the first call (same job). Keep it secret.

max_respondents.description: Number of synthetic personas (10-100, default 30). Smaller surveys finish within one call more often.

questions.description: 1 to 3 survey questions (choice with 2-10 options, or free_text).

target_description.description: Optional natural-language filter by age band, gender, region (e.g. '30〜40代', '40〜59歳の女性'). Not occupation.

wait_for_completion.description: Wait in-call (up to 30s) for the result. false returns the job handle immediately.

wait_seconds.description: Upper bound of the in-call wait in seconds.

name: cloneai_synthetic_persona_survey
title: Run Japanese Synthetic Persona Survey (In-Call Wait + Agent Hub Recall)
